text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas. The Satono Group's
party was bustling with many guests and associates.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan!
Merry Christmas♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas, Dia!
Looks like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah. After all, the big stage at the end of the year is waiting.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to throw everything I have
into this "festival" with Kita-chan—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Today's a day to hype things up
and have as much fun as we can♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In that case, maybe I should let my hair down
just as much so I won't lose to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
She's steadily growing stronger, isn't she?
Public attention on her is rising too.
choice_data_list: We can't afford to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Seeing fellow Satono Umamusume push each other to greater heights.
It is truly magnificent, Lady Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah! Madam President. It has been a long time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. This is the chairman of a major trading firm.
He has very close ties with my father's company.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, so you're Miss Crown's Trainer.
I've heard from her that you're quite capable.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
"Not only are they a skilled Trainer,
but they're also said to be exceptional with business support."
choice_data_list: In the end, it's all thanks to her own ability

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, this attitude of supporting your trainee.
Yes, yes, truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text: An acquaintance of mine has a pre-debut trainee! I'd love to introduce her to someone like you, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Please do not go any further than that,
Madam President."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because to me,
he is an irreplaceable partner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "She is an irreplaceable partner to me, after all."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, you completely outdid me there.
I surrender, I surrender.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh please, stop teasing your juniors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The party ended, and on the way home...
I remembered what was said at the venue, and couldn't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
What's up, Trainer?
Grinning like that.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I just got so happy...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're talking about irreplaceable partners?
—Well, of course, because that's exactly what we are.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You're watching over me more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: During our provisional contract, when I had lost valuable practice time, you put together the perfect training routine for me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And through it all, ever since then,
as I raced through every single race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Whenever a wall I had to overcome appeared,
she was right beside me, firing me up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Someone like you?
――As if I'd ever want to let you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be evaluated so highly fills me with deep emotion.
If so, then I must live up to those expectations."
choice_data_list: I'm gonna try even harder, just watch!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I have high expectations of you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, would you mind if we took a little detour?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place I stopped by with Satono Crown
was a department store basement in the thick of the Christmas rush.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, chiffon, chocolate, cheese...
Ice cream is also an option.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a Christmas cake.
I thought we could celebrate privately this time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Because it's Christmas, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Don't you just want to let loose and go wild with someone you can be yourself around? Right?
choice_data_list: Then, wanna get some chicken too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! And some sparkling juice,
plus party crackers too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Once again... Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'm going to cut the cake!
I'll give you the cookie nameplate!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Board games after cake!
Let's see who can win more games!
choice_data_list: Fufu, you're just like a kid.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"—Why not?
Once in a while!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Christmas night
lively drew to a close.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hao sai lei aa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The illuminated Furlong Tower takes your breath away.
It is almost like—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The Tower of Light...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Reminds me of my time in Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: When I was a kid, you know, the whole family always got together for Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Enjoy the illuminated scenery,
and after that, we exchange presents..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's my Christmas... No.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It was a way to spend time with someone precious.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So... here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, Merry Christmas.
Would you open it for me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unwrapping it carefully revealed a wallet adorned with a crown emblem.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I had it custom-made.
I hope you like it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A custom-made wallet... I have a good idea
of why she chose that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was a little while ago.
To celebrate a milestone in my Trainer career..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh! Did you get a necktie?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did you know?
Gifts like jewelry and accessories
actually carry hidden messages.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: A necktie means "I respect you," and shoes mean "celebrating a fresh start."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the message inside the wallet read—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I want to keep running forever.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Together with you, and no one else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took those words to heart.
I felt the exact same way she did.
choice_data_list: Likewise, I look forward to continuing to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gaze up at the starry sky alongside Satono Crown.
And so, the Christmas night drew to a close.
